item.title: From Love to Horror: Manipur Woman Allegedly Stabs South Korean Partner in Noida
item.description: A South Korean man was allegedly killed by his live-in partner, a woman from Manipur, following an argument in a high-rise apartment in Greater Noida today. The woman, identified as Lunjeana Pamai, has been taken into custody and is being questioned by police. item.title: Assam Wakes Up to 5.1 Magnitude Quake, Tremors Felt Across Northeast
item.description: A moderate earthquake shook large parts of Assam early Monday, briefly triggering panic among residents across several districts. The tremor was felt around 4:17 am, jolting people awake and sending many out of their homes as a precaution. According to the National Centre for Seismology, the earthquake measured 5.1 on the Richter scale and originated in Morigaon district in central Assam. item.title: Manipur Farmer Sees Brighter Days as Fields Turn Green Again
item.description: In Manipur’s Bishnupur district, a small vegetable farm is slowly turning into a symbol of hope after years of hardship. Ningthoujam Inaocha from Kumbi Terakha is finally seeing brighter days after suffering heavy losses during the COVID-19 years and the long spell of unrest in the state. item.title: Assam Earthquake: Three Injured in Morigaon While Rushing Outside Home
item.description: Three people were reportedly injured in Assam's Morigaon district following the earthquake today early morning. According to sources, the injuries occurred when residents rushed out of their homes during the tremors.
